question: How much does it cost to install vinyl plank flooring in Sarasota, FL?
title: Vinyl Plank Flooring Cost in Sarasota, FL (2026)
h1: How Much Does Vinyl Plank Flooring Cost to Install in Sarasota?
description: Installed vinyl plank flooring in Sarasota and Manatee County runs $1.75-$9.50 per sq ft in 2026, depending on mil rating, core type and removal.
capsule: Installed vinyl plank flooring in Sarasota and Manatee County typically runs $1.75 to $9.50 per square foot in 2026. Standard 12-mil product installs for $1.75-$3.25, mid-range 20-mil SPC for $2.75-$5.50, and wide-plank luxury vinyl for $5.50-$9.50. The spread depends on wear layer thickness, core material, and whether old flooring has to come out first.

sections.h2: What Does Installed Vinyl Plank Flooring Cost in Sarasota?
sections.html:
If you searched for flooring installers near me and landed here, welcome, we install vinyl plank flooring across Sarasota and Manatee County every week and price it in tiers, because a builder-grade 12-mil floor and a 22-mil commercial-grade SPC floor aren't the same product even though both get called "LVP" online. Standard 12-mil vinyl plank installs for $1.75-$3.25 per square foot. Mid-range SPC with a 20-mil wear layer runs $2.75-$5.50. Premium SPC at 22 mil or thicker runs $4.25-$7.50, and wide-plank luxury vinyl, the wider boards that mimic 7-9 in. European oak, runs $5.50-$9.50. If you need glue-down commercial-grade product for a rental or a high-traffic room, figure $3.25-$6.50 per square foot.

National sources land in a similar band. This Old House put combined material-plus-labor LVP costs at $6-$20 per square foot as of their June 2026 update, and a Sarasota-specific cost page from homeyou (dated August 2026) listed vinyl and linoleum installs starting around $2.50-$4 per square foot for a basic project. Our ranges sit inside both, because we quote by product tier rather than a single blended number, and every tier we install is genuinely waterproof at the core, not just at the surface finish.

sections.h2: What Would 1,000 Square Feet of Vinyl Plank Flooring Cost?
sections.html:
At our installed ranges, 1,000 square feet of vinyl plank runs roughly $1,750-$9,500 depending on tier, before demo or slab prep. A 1,400 sq ft block ranch in Gulf Gate built in the 1970s, replacing worn carpet and vinyl composition tile with a mid-range 20-mil SPC, lands around $3,850-$7,700 once you add flooring removal.

Removal isn't included in the per-square-foot flooring price. Click-together LVP removal runs $1.00-$2.50 per square foot, stretch-in carpet runs $0.50-$1.25, and glue-down flooring is more labor, $3.00-$4.50 per square foot, according to a February 2026 Southwest Florida removal cost guide. On an older home where the vinyl was glued directly to the slab, that removal line can add more to the job than the new flooring's material cost.

sections.h2: What Changes the Price Per Square Foot?
sections.html:
Wear layer thickness is the biggest lever: a 12-mil layer handles a light-traffic guest room, but a kitchen or a rental unit needs 20 mil or more to resist scuffs and rolling chair casters. Core type matters next. SPC (stone-plastic composite) is rigid and dimensionally stable, which we lean on for Gulf Coast humidity swings; WPC (wood-plastic composite) is softer underfoot but moves more with temperature, so we use it more selectively here than in a drier climate.

Beyond the plank itself, three things swing a Sarasota quote: whether the slab needs self-leveling ($250-$700 per room), whether the old floor has to come out, and how much trim and transition work the layout needs. We take a slab moisture reading as part of every estimate before quoting vinyl or wood, at no extra charge, because a slab that reads above the manufacturer's RH limit changes which product and waterproof flooring underlayment we'd recommend. A wider board also shows a wavy subfloor more than a narrow one does, which is worth knowing if you're set on the wide-plank luxury tier.

sections.h2: Getting an Accurate Number for Your House
sections.html:
Square-footage calculators get you in the right neighborhood, but the only way to know your real number is a written, line-itemized quote: material, labor, removal, prep and trim broken out separately, not bundled into one lump sum. We do free in-home estimates across Sarasota and Manatee counties, including Lakewood Ranch where we're based, and reply within 24 hours.

For a quick ballpark before you call, our flooring cost calculator walks through room size and product tier, or try the Florida flooring finder if you're still choosing between vinyl and another material. When you're ready for real numbers, request a free estimate and we'll come measure and test the slab in person.

faqs.q: Is vinyl plank flooring cheaper than tile in Sarasota?
faqs.a: At the entry level, yes. Standard 12-mil vinyl plank starts around $1.75 per square foot installed, while 12-18 in. porcelain tile starts around $6 per square foot. Premium wide-plank vinyl and mid-range tile overlap more, so the gap narrows as you move up in quality.

faqs.q: Does the vinyl plank price include removing old flooring?
faqs.a: No, removal is a separate line item on our quotes. Click LVP removal runs about $1.00-$2.50 per square foot and glued flooring runs more, so we price it based on what's actually coming up in your house.

faqs.q: Do you charge extra for the slab moisture test?
faqs.a: No. A moisture reading is part of every wood and vinyl estimate at no additional charge, because it affects which underlayment and installation method we'd recommend before you ever see a number.
